largeheadline_copy_c.line1: About us
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: At Stryker, our goal is to keep you focused on what matters most – the safety of your patients and the efficiency of your staff.

text.text:
ProCare is dedicated to being your trusted and proactive service partner – promising to provide flexible service solutions to help maximize uptime without sacrificing safety for savings. As the original equipment manufacturer, we provide unmatched service - with original Stryker parts, proprietary product knowledge and our team of expert service professionals.

We are the gold standard in care for your equipment.

largeheadline_copy_c_1436919098.line1: ProCare advantage

text.text:
We don't just offer service solutions - it's a partnership you can count on.

Click the tabs below to discover the ProCare difference.

Maximizing uptime 

Proactive care and maintenance delivered by our expert team of service professionals to ensure your Stryker equipment is operating at peak performance. We are committed to maintaining device reliability, prioritizing patient safety all while delivering maximized equipment uptime.

text_copy.text:
Flexible service solutions

One size doesn’t fit all. We offer flexible service solutions tailored to meet your facility’s needs - don’t sacrifice safety for savings. We'll work together to create a fixed-cost plan that ensures the exceptional care and performance of your Stryker equipment.

OEM quality and reliability

There is no one more qualified to maintain and service your Stryker equipment than the experts who created it. Our technicians have the proprietary knowledge, exclusive access to original parts and specialized training to protect your investment, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your patients. Trust your critical equipment to the best.

Clinical workflow efficiency

Our highly trained ProCare Specialists offer expertise in managing your high-tech Stryker equipment while adhering to OEM standards for on-label utilization. We partner with you to streamline workflows, minimize operational interruptions and support your team in delivering the standard of care your patients expect.
